summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on verifying the correct usage and display of modeled dwell time. Initial queries were made regarding checking if the new modeled dwell time feature was active. It was noted that company IDs must be accurate for testing, and a check should ideally be performed on the live site or by the company's parent/administrator.

[me] provided a complex SQL query structure to test various user settings, specifically targeting `dashboard.useModelledDwellTime` and filtering by specific `company_id` sequences (8004, 7977).

Later discussion clarified that if the data is incomplete, it suggests that global values are being pulled where the company ID is null. It was concluded that clarity on this matter will be available after a release.
decisions: The current issue with modeled dwell time display (incomplete fields) is attributed to pulling global values when the company ID is null.
action_items: Wait for the next release to gain full clarity on the modeled dwell time implementation.
